data.title: Documentation is an entity in the journal (doc.written revisions), not .md files
data.why: Owner, 2026-09-18: documentation differs from a note and must be quick for an agent to read; files beside the journal break the concept. Measured: 70 md docs, 0 doc links in our own journal. Revisions carry parents so a concurrent edit is a surfaced conflict, never a loss (I1).
data.rejected: Keep ADR-010 files plus links; Confluence/Notion connector; md files that kadence creates and indexes
